name: exiledata-assets
description: Static CDN of PoE2 item art (.webp) + skill videos (.webm). `npm start` serves the tree locally over HTTP on :4201 via wrangler, honoring _headers so local dev mirrors the deployed Cloudflare Pages site. NOTE the PINNED --compatibility-date: with no date wrangler defaults to TODAY, and the bundled workerd only supports dates up to its own build, so `start` breaks the moment the calendar passes it (it did on 2026-07-30: 'requires compatibility date 2026-07-30, but the newest date supported by this server binary is 2026-07-29'). The exact value is irrelevant here — this project has no Functions — it only has to be fixed rather than floating.
